text: dsh-skill-panel 是面向 DSH 网页端的技能管理插件，在设置页、侧边栏和浮层提供 Skills 面板。它通过宿主服务读取当前会话可见的技能目录，并用浏览器界面展示技能名称、来源、描述和详情。用户可以搜索与筛选技能、切换模型或用户调用权限、暂时禁用或恢复技能、卸载本地技能，也能创建分组并管理成员。它适合需要在 DSH 网页端整理 agent skills 的用户。运行需要 Harness 提供技能、会话和插槽服务；文件修改与卸载分别依赖 fs 和 subprocess，分组使用 storageDomain。

dsh-skill-panel adds a Skills panel to DSH web settings, sidebar, and overlay. Users can browse, search, and filter session-visible skills, inspect details, change invocation switches, disable or uninstall local skills, and organize skills into groups. It relies on host skill and slot services.
想在 DSH 网页端查看当前会话能用哪些技能。
我需要按名称搜索并按来源筛选 agent skills。
怎么查看一个技能的说明和 SKILL.md 内容？
希望分别控制某个技能能否被模型调用或由用户调用。
想暂时停用一个技能，之后还能恢复原来的开关状态。
如何从 DSH 面板卸载本地安装的技能？
我想把技能归类到自定义分组并维护组成员。
需要从设置页或侧边栏快速打开技能管理界面。
Show me the skills available to my current DSH session.
I want to search skills and filter them by where they came from.
How can I organize my agent skills into named groups?
Let me control whether a skill is available to the model or the user.
dsh-skill-panel 的功能「技能目录浏览」：面板列出会话可见的技能及名称、描述和来源，并支持搜索和来源筛选。可从设置页或侧边栏打开。
dsh-skill-panel 的功能「查看技能详情」：展开技能条目后读取详情，展示 whenToUse、路径和技能正文。正文读取上限为 50000 个字符。
dsh-skill-panel 的功能「调用权限与禁用恢复」：用户可分别切换模型调用和用户调用，也可禁用后恢复此前状态；已打包技能不可修改，且至少保留一个调用入口。
dsh-skill-panel 的功能「卸载本地技能」：对可卸载的本地技能进行二次确认后删除技能文件或目录；内置技能不能卸载。
dsh-skill-panel 的功能「技能分组」：可创建、重命名、删除分组并添加或移除技能成员；分组数据保存在宿主 storageDomain。

dsh-skill-panel README · dsh-skill-panel：A skill management panel for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web app: browse, search, filter, enable/disable, and uninstall your agent skills from the settings page or the sidebar.

dsh-skill-panel README · dsh-skill-panel：Built entirely on the harness's public plugin surface — a Typert Remote service on the host half, slot-registered React UI on the browser half. No forks, no internal APIs, no build step (pure JS); runtime imports are limited to the harness-provided `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain` and `zod` (declared as dependencies).

dsh-skill-panel README · Features：- Skill list with name, description, source label, and per-source counts
- Search and source filtering (user `.agents`, user `.dsh`, project roots, custom, bundled)
- **Model** / **User** invocation switches (rewrites the SKILL.md frontmatter; unspecified switches are preserved)
- **Disable / Enable** button — fully disables a skill while remembering its previous state, and restores exactly that state on enable
- **Uninstall** with two-step confirm (deletes the skill directory, bundled skills are protected)
- Detail view with `whenToUse`, on-disk path, and the SKILL.md body
- **Skill groups** — create / rename / delete groups, manage membership per group (add / remove skills), browse skills grouped; persisted through the official `ctx.storageDomain` (no self-made storage files)
- All reads are session-scoped — the panel shows exactly the catalog your current session serves
- Writes invalidate discovery synchronously, and the slash-menu cache is refreshed through the official forwarded events

dsh-skill-panel README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6+` (web profile)
- pnpm available (`corepack enable` provides it)

dsh-skill-panel README · Install：```sh
corepack enable                                   # once per machine
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-panel     # from npm

dsh-skill-panel README · or: dsh plugin --profile web add github:nianchen8/dsh-skill-panel：dsh web                                           # restart to load the package
```

The panel then appears under **Settings → Skills** and the sidebar's **Skills** button.

dsh-skill-panel README · How it works：```
SKILL.md files (project / user / bundled roots)
        │  discovery (skill-filesystem providers, layered per scope)
        ▼
host skill registry  ── snapshot({cwd, scope: agent}) ──► SkillPanelService (Typert Remote)

dsh-skill-panel README · How it works：- **Host half** (`index.js`): a `TypertRemoteService` with twelve Remote endpoints — `getConfig`, `listDetailed`, `getDetail`, `setInvocation`, `setDisabled`, `uninstall`, plus the group CRUD `groupList`, `groupCreate`, `groupUpdate`, `groupDelete`, `groupAddSkill`, `groupRemoveSkill`. Reads resolve the session-scoped skill view (same catalog the model sees); writes rewrite SKILL.md frontmatter or delete the skill directory, then emit `fs/observed` for synchronous discovery invalidation and replay `agent-preset/selected` so the official slash menu drops its cached catalog. Groups live in a `ctx.storageDomain` domain (`skill_groups`), opened lazily and closed on unload; when storage is unavailable the panel degrades to a read-only group view.
- **Browser half** (`client.js`): plain React via the platform module table, registered into `sidebar.footer.action`, `shell.overlay`, and `settings.section`. All data crosses the standard API gateway over `/api/skillPanel/<method>`.

dsh-skill-panel README · Placement configuration：The three UI entries (sidebar button, overlay, settings page) default to the **tail** of their slot: at registration the browser half reads the slot's live entries and places itself after the largest existing `order`, so a fresh deployment always lands at the bottom of the list regardless of how many entries already occupy the slot.

dsh-skill-panel README · Placement configuration：**Arrival semantics (why same-strategy plugins don't fight):** the tail order is computed **once at registration** — the browser half never re-registers after it arrives. Each registration is an atomic read→compute→register, so the next arrival always sees the previous one and appends strictly after it (`max + 1`, no ties). Once an entry lands, its position is fixed; if it later unloads and comes back (fiber restart), it re-appends at the tail again. Two plugins using this identical strategy therefore coexist as A(0), B(1), C(2), … with the latest arrival always last — no chasing, no livelock.

dsh-skill-panel README · Placement configuration：Each entry can be individually overridden through the loader entry's `config` in the profile composition (`profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml

dsh-skill-panel README · Placement configuration：- `enabled` — whether the entry registers at all.
- `order` — exact ascending position in the slot; **absent means dynamic tail** (`max existing order + 1` at registration time).
- `slot` — target slot key; omit for the built-in seats above. When relocating, the component degrades gracefully to the props the new slot provides (`useSessions`/`wide` are optional in the panel code).

dsh-skill-panel README · Placement configuration：The resolved placement is exposed to the browser through `skillPanel/getConfig`; if the endpoint is unavailable (e.g. before a restart), the browser half falls back to the defaults above.

dsh-skill-panel README · Development：The package is pure JavaScript; edit `index.js` / `client.js`, then restart `dsh web` (the client bundle is rescanned at boot).

```sh
node --check index.js client.js
npx oxlint --deny-warnings index.js client.js
```
